comment: Mutant dh-ratchet-no-send-step: RatchetState::dh_ratchet_step performs only the receiving DH half-step and omits rotating self.sender_chain with a fresh ephemeral keypair. Bob encrypts his reply under his static signed pre-key and initial PQXDH handshake chain key, and Alice accepts it via her pre-populated SPK receiver chain without stepping her DH ratchet.
